C1552.title: Analysis of Seven Critical Vulnerabilities in Cross-Chain Bridges
C1552.summary: According to DefiLlama, cumulative stolen funds from cross-chain bridges have exceeded $2.8 billion, accounting for about 40% of the total stolen funds across the Web3 industry ($7.68 billion), making it one of the most attacked sectors. The article analyzes seven critical vulnerabilities in cross-chain bridges, including private key management, smart contract auditing, and upgrade processes, revealing the systemic security risks in bridging.

references.title: Understanding the Seven Key Vulnerabilities of Cross-Chain Bridges in One Article
